clips.title: The story
paras: Baros Alexston seeks help from his home in Stormwind's Cathedral Square. His family's Westfall farm has burned, and thieves hold its ruins; he hopes to recover an heirloom from his youth.

Baros Alexston grew up working the fields of Westfall. Now he is an accomplished architect in Stormwind City, advising on stonework and city buildings. His path from farm boy to city planner is rare in the kingdom, yet he remains attached to the modest beginnings that shaped him.

Lawlessness swept across Westfall, and the Alexston Farmstead fell to it. Bandits and vagrants burned the house, forcing Baros's father from his livelihood. Family heirlooms were left behind amid the fire and occupation. Baros asks you to search the ruined, bandit-held farmstead west of Sentinel Hill for his first compass, hidden before the home fell.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It seems an eternity since I was a boy working the farm in Westfall. They say you can never go back, and it's true. Doubly true in my case, my family's home has been burned down and taken over by thieves.
I have spoken with my father about the fate of some of my possessions, including my first compass. He was unable to save them. However, he also says that they should be hidden away on the farm.
You'll find the Alexston Farmstead west of Sentinel Hill. Perhaps you could go and retrieve it for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend! Did you have any luck?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, thank you, friend! It's of no practical use to me, but the sentimental value... Needless to say, thank you for bringing this to me... At some cost to your own well-being, not to mention the time it took to go all the way down to Westfall. You have my gratitude, and have this as a token of my thanks.
